verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can grant edit access so colleagues can modify a design and chat with Claude together in a group conversation, and designs can be shared via an org-scoped link. That is a basic shared-editing model, but nothing shows true simultaneous multiplayer editing. Missing for 10: evidence of concurrent real-time co-editing, live cursors/presence indicators, instant sync, conflict handling, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.
